writeup: TIC 235512374 is a newly discovered eclipsing binary star system that has not appeared in any existing variable-star catalogs. The two stars orbit each other every 3.7441 days, causing the primary star to dim by 3.41 percent as its companion passes in front of it. Astronomers also detected a secondary eclipse, where the primary star blocks light from its companion, confirming the binary nature of the system. The detection shows strong statistical significance with a signal-to-noise ratio of 173.8 from automated analysis. All data quality checks passed cleanly, and independent pixel-level imaging confirmed the signal, making this a robust and genuine astronomical discovery.
